text:
Maya: Heads up — our commitment renewal window for a bunch of GPU reservations / savings plans opens next Tue. Can we do a quick triage on underutilized commitments and decide rebalancing vs letting lapse?

Sam: +1. I ran the 30d utilization query this morning. High-level: eu-west and apac are low, us-east looks tight.

Sam: ```
region        instance_family  coverage_pct  idle_gpu_hrs_month
us-east-1     p4de             85%           1,200
eu-west-1     p4d              46%           3,200
ap-southeast-1 p3              30%           4,300
```

Jordan: Oof apac is painful. Those are mostly Dedicated pool allocations for AI research jobs, right? If Dedicated is ~30% idle we should either reduce reserved nodes or open burst capacity for spot.

Eli: Confirmed — apac Dedicated has several long-running but intermittent workloads. We can rightsize a couple of 8xA100 pools to 4x and move non-critical batch to spot. That would free up reservation coverage immediately.

Priya: From finance — last quarter we committed to a blended 3yr plan; we have some convertible RIs and regional EC2 Savings Plans. We need a recommendation (keep, convert, sell) + expected $ impact before the renewal window closes. Can you give a table of options?

Maya: I'll draft options. Quick thinking:
- Convert some region-specific RIs in eu-west -> Savings Plan for flexibility (lower $ benefit but less waste).
- Let a subset of apac commit lapse and switch those workloads to on-demand + spot with autoscaler.
- For us-east, increase reserved capacity for P4d/p4de for steady inference fleets.

ops-bot: Automated report: savingsplan-utilization: 72% (30d rolling). projected-unused-commit-hours: 9,600. Next renewal date: 1769040000.

Sam: Financial delta estimate (very rough): converting eu-west RIs -> Compute SP reduces expected savings from 58% to 45% on that footprint, but reduces waste and gives redeploy flexibility — net +$14k/yr vs holding awkward RIs.

Jordan: We should also consider moving some experimental research pools onto short-term Dedicated bursts we spin up only during runs (ci-style). That lowers committed baseline.

Eli: Actionable items I can take this afternoon: 1) run cluster-by-cluster breakdown of idle GPU hours, 2) tag non-production nodes for potential autoscaling, 3) simulate impact of dropping 2 apac reserved nodes (estimate saved commit $/mo).

Maya: Perfect. Priya, can you confirm the finance cutoff and whether we can do partial term conversions? Also, if we decide to sell Convertible RIs, need owner approval.

Priya: Cutoff is EOD Friday for any conversion requests to hit the next billing cycle review. Partial conversions ok but need exact SKUs. I'll review once you share the list.

Sam: SQL I used for the quick report if anyone wants to rerun: ```
SELECT region, instance_family, SUM(usage_hours) AS used_hours, SUM(reserved_hours)-SUM(usage_hours) AS idle_hours
FROM billing_gpu_hourly
WHERE start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```

Maya: Cool. I'll consolidate the data and post a decision doc here by Thu AM with recommended convert/sell/let-lapse actions and estimated $ impact. If anyone spots a major flaw in the approach call it out now. :eyes:

Jordan: No blockers from infra side. If we decide to release capacity in apac, please add a short runway window so teams can adapt.

Eli: I'll attach the cluster-level numbers to your doc, Maya.

Maya: Thanks — we'll reconvene Thurs 10am to finalize. :calendar:
